tha-ap130:2.1: upanidhā → upanidhaṁ (sya-all) | upanidhā → upanidhaṁ (bj: sī.selu) | upanidhā → S1 G. upaṅidhaṁ; S2 ñānena upanidaṁ. (pts note)
tha-ap130:2.2: saṅkhāraṁ → saṅgāmaṁ (sya-all) | saṅgāmaṁ → saṅkhāraṁ (bj: machasaṁ) | saṅkhāraṁ → saṅgāmaṁ (cck: sī. syā.); saṅkhātaṁ (cck: theragāthā aṭṭha.)
tha-ap130:2.4: adhimuccati → G. adhivuccati; S2 avimuccati. (pts note)
tha-ap130:3.4: ñāṇamuttamaṁ → ñāṇamuttame (pts) | ñāṇamuttamaṁ → muttame (bj: PTS, sī.selu)
tha-ap130:4.4: caritaṁ → karitaṁ (sya-all) | karitaṁ → caritaṁ (bj: machasaṁ) | caritaṁ → karitaṁ (cck: sī. syā.); kiriyaṁ (cck: ka.) | kāritaṁ → G. kusalakaritaṁ. (pts note)
tha-ap130:5.1: ekanavutito → ekanavute ito (bj, sya-all, pts) | ito → ekanavutito (bj: machasaṁ)
tha-ap130:6.1: sattatikappamhi → tesattatikappe (sya-all, pts) | tesattatikappe → sattatikappemhi (bj: machasaṁ) | sattatikappamhi → tesattatikappe (cck: sī. syā.)
tha-ap130:6.2: pulinapupphiyo → puḷinapupphiyo (sya-all, pts) | Puḷinapupphiyo → G. Phūḷīna-. (pts note)
